basis: All quantities and loaded internal rates below are illustrative planning assumptions, not measured costs, quoted provider rates, or contract terms.

onsite.treatment: Separate prior written authorization and agreed cost treatment. Remote scenarios exclude onsite costs.

tax_and_unmodeled_overhead: Not separately modeled. Loaded rate assumptions must be replaced with actual fully burdened costs before financial reliance.
interpretation: Remaining headroom is an illustrative planning balance, not earned profit or a payment claim. Price stays 4000 for either session count; no automatic one-session discount. Timing, attendees, scope and any travel require separate agreement. Factual defects remain correctable and do not become paid extras solely because a planning allowance is exceeded.
